findings.title: Upstream repository URL referenced in source
findings.reason: A repository URL in a source comment is frequently the only surviving record of where a snippet came from, and is worth resolving into a documented provenance entry while the trail is still warm.
findings.recommendation: Determine whether code was actually incorporated from this repository.  If it was, record the license and version; if it is only a reference, classify it as such so it stops being flagged.

triage.rationale: A reference to an upstream repository URL. Each vendored tree is recorded in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES with its source, licence and local modifications; these references are the provenance trail rather than an undisclosed dependency.
